C1008.title: A Professional Gold Farmer's Account: From Solo Play to Running a Legend of Mir Gold Farming Studio
C1008.summary: A professional gold farmer recounts entering the trade around 2016. He chose freely tradable games like Legend of Mir, using multiple accounts and auxiliary scripts to mass-farm in-game currency and equipment, then converting them into real money through gold and item transfers. Scaling from a single machine to an eight-machine studio, his daily profit once exceeded 800 yuan with an annual income

references.title: The Most Comprehensive Guide to Grinding Gold, from Zero to Stable Income
